card.fires_on: Small words and number pieces inside rough quantities or dates, such as "quarter of", "into the" billions, "thirty or" forty, or the last digit of a year. The next word is usually a unit of time or magnitude.

modes.label: Linking word in a rough range
modes.description: A word like "of", "the" or "or" that sits between rough counts or fractions before a big unit.
